parameters.query: WITH org AS (SELECT id FROM organizations WHERE slug=$1 LIMIT 1), c AS (INSERT INTO contacts(organization_id,external_id,name,phone,email) SELECT id,$2,$3,$4,$5 FROM org ON CONFLICT(organization_id,external_id) DO UPDATE SET name=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.name,contacts.name),phone=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.phone,contacts.phone),email=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.email,contacts.email),updated_at=now() RETURNING id,organization_id), conv AS (INSERT INTO conversations(organization_id,contact_id,channel,external_id,last_message_at) SELECT organization_id,id,$6,$7,now() FROM c ON CONFLICT(organization_id,channel,external_id) DO UPDATE SET last_message_at=now(),updated_at=now() RETURNING id,organization_id) INSERT INTO messages(organization_id,conversation_id,direction,message_type,body,payload,provider_message_id,idempotency_key) SELECT organization_id,id,'in',$8,$9,$10::jsonb,$11,$12 FROM conv ON CONFLICT(organization_id,idempotency_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING *;
